mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in housing starts (HOUST) signals weakening residential construction activity and consumer confidence, which typically precedes negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as corporate revenue expectations deteriorate.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in more than 60% of instances when HOUST declines, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) rises above 4.5% in a 3-month window, it signals aggressive monetary tightening that increases equity discount rates and reduces valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in more than 60% of triggered instances, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in unemployment rate (UNRATE) and decline in retail sales (RSAFS) signals dual deterioration in labor market health and consumer spending, which typically triggers negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 days as recession risks intensify.
candidate_trigger: UNRATE rises > 0.2pp and RSAFS falls > 0.5% in 1 month
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in more than 60% of instances when both conditions are met, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In high-inflation regimes (CPIAUCSL > 3.0%), a rising unemployment rate (UNRATE) signals that the economy is entering a recession, which typically leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 days as central bank response lags.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in more than 60% of instances when CPIAUCSL > 3.0% and UNRATE rises, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production (INDPRO) signals weakening manufacturing output and supply chain stress, which typically leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 days as corporate earnings face headwinds.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in more than 60% of instances when INDPRO declines, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When monthly payroll employment (PAYEMS) declines by more than 50,000 in a single month, it signals significant labor market deterioration, which typically leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 days as recession risks rise.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in more than 60% of triggered instances, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in inflation (CPIAUCSL) and decline in housing starts (HOUST) signals stagflationary pressures, which typically leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 days as central banks face a difficult trade-off between growth and inflation.
candidate_trigger: CPIAUCSL rises > 0.3pp and HOUST falls > 1.0% in 1 month
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in more than 60% of instances when both conditions are met, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In late-cycle expansion regimes (GDPC1 growth > 2.5% annually), a decline in retail sales (RSAFS) signals a potential consumer spending slowdown, which typically leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 days as the economy approaches a peak.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in more than 60% of instances when GDPC1 growth > 2.5% and RSAFS declines, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.
